name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_map
statement: S} {f : S →ₐ[R] T} (hf : Function.Injective f) (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R (f x)) : IsStronglyTranscendental R x

have_tree.body: h (f u) p (by rw [aeval_algHom_apply, ← map_mul, hp, map_zero])

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_isLocalization_left
statement: Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] [IsScalarTower R S T] {x : T} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) : IsStronglyTranscendental S x

have_tree.body: h t (IsLocalization.integerNormalization M p) (by simp [H, hp])

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.iff_of_isFractionRing
statement: Type*) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K] [FaithfulSMul R S] [IsFractionRing S K] {x : S} : IsStronglyTranscendental R x ↔ Transcendental R (algebraMap S K x)

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_transcendental
statement: Type*} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K] [FaithfulSMul R S] [FaithfulSMul S K] {x : S} (H : Transcendental R (algebraMap S K x)) : IsStronglyTranscendental R x

name: isStronglyTranscendental_mk_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement: S} (hx : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) (q : Ideal S) (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) : IsStronglyTranscendental R (Ideal.Quotient.mk q x)
